tile_deck.note: 29 remaining tiles (1 start tile pre-placed on the board); server shuffles and draws

board.note: 20x20 grid; start tile placed at center (10,10); tiles placed adjacent to existing tiles with matching edges

meeple_supply.note: each player's unplaced meeples; returned when features complete

tile.note: each tile instance has north_edge, east_edge, south_edge, west_edge set to one of: city, road, field; some tiles have monastery or pennant flags

meeple.note: placed on a feature (city, road, monastery, field) of the tile just placed this turn

phases.name: draw_tile
phases.action: reveal drawn tile to all players

phases.name: place_tile
phases.note: tile must be placed adjacent to an existing tile; all edges touching neighbors must match (city-city, road-road, field-field); tile may be rotated 0/90/180/270 degrees

phases.name: place_meeple
phases.trigger: after place_tile, if player has meeple in supply
phases.note: meeple goes on one feature (city, road, monastery, field) of the tile just placed; the connected feature must not already have a meeple from any player

phases.name: score_completed
phases.note: check if tile placement completed any cities (2pt/tile + 2pt/pennant), roads (1pt/tile), or monasteries (9pt if fully surrounded); return meeples to owners

constraints: cell must be orthogonally adjacent to at least one placed tile
all edges touching adjacent tiles must match terrain type (city-city, road-road, field-field)

tile_rotation.definition: tiles may be rotated 0, 90, 180, or 270 degrees before placement

constraints: player must have at least one meeple in supply
meeple is placed on the tile just placed this turn
chosen feature (city, road, monastery, field) must not already be occupied by any meeple on connected segments

city_scoring.effect: 2 points per tile in city + 2 per pennant; return meeples to owners
city_scoring.note: incomplete cities score 1 per tile + 1 per pennant at game end

road_scoring.trigger: road feature connects two endpoints (intersection, city, or dead end)
road_scoring.effect: 1 point per tile in road; return meeples to owners
road_scoring.note: incomplete roads score 1 per tile at game end

monastery_scoring.trigger: monastery tile is completely surrounded (8 adjacent tiles placed)
monastery_scoring.effect: 9 points (1 for monastery + 8 surrounding); return meeple to owner
monastery_scoring.note: incomplete monasteries score 1 + number of surrounding tiles at game end

field_scoring.effect: 3 points per completed city adjacent to the field
field_scoring.note: fields are scored only at game end; meeples on fields are never returned during play

majority_rule.definition: when a feature has multiple meeples (via merging), the player(s) with the most meeples score; tied players all receive full points

end_conditions.condition: tile_deck is empty AND final scoring complete
end_conditions.name: all_tiles_placed

end_conditions.condition: tile_deck is empty AND final scoring complete AND scores are tied
end_conditions.name: tied_scores
